title: Registering New Team Members on either the Left or Right
description: Using the various Referral Links in Mirror Trading International Join the official MTI Members News Channel on Telegram ...

asr.full_text: Registering new team members on either the left or right. When you send someone your registration link, the system will place the person in your weaker leg. You can find your registration link in your back office. Near the bottom of the menu, if you are using a small screen or a mobile device you may need to scroll down a bit, you will see a referral link. Click on this. You'll be taken to a screen which gives you a few options. At the top you will see your registration link. You can copy this and send it to your prospects. When they click on the link, they will see your registration sign up page. Once they have registered, they will be placed in your weakest leg, unless you have instructed them to choose a specific leg. How can I make sure my new members go into either the left or right leg of my business? In the menu on the left when you click on referral link, amongst the options, you will see specific placement registration links. Look at these links a bit closer and you will discover three different options. Auto, left or right. All that is left is to decide which link you would be sharing first. It may be a good idea to speak to the person who sponsored you and plan a little more strategically. As your team grows you may want to give out a specific placement link. When in doubt use the first registration link and the system will automatically place the person in the weakest leg of your business. For more information please contact your team leader

textual.context: The source presents this as a how-to explanation for members using referral links; promotion versus neutral instruction is unclear from the supplied records.
textual.potential_relevance: The cited statements link a requested recruitment action, sending a registration link to prospects, with a referral placement structure in a business team, including specific left/right placement options.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish payment, investment terms, promised returns, actual registration outcomes, website contents, or whether Mirror Trading International affiliation is authorized.

visual.observation: The presentation promotes registering new team members through a branded back-office referral link, with separate registration links for automatic, left-leg, and right-leg placement in a displayed team structure.
visual.context: The material appears to be an instructional demonstration of the Mirror Trading International back office and its referral-placement options; whether registration involves payment or what participants receive is not shown.
visual.potential_relevance: A recruitment step is directly linked to using a referral registration destination and assigning the recruit within a two-leg business structure, which may merit review as a referral-based enrollment mechanism.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish that anyone registered, paid money, provided sensitive information, received a reward, or experienced a loss. The sampled frames also do not establish the nature or legitimacy of the organization or links.

The presentation directs viewers to contact their team leader for more information.

annotation.contextual_rationale: The video gives members operational instructions for copying a Mirror Trading International registration link and sending it to prospects, making recruitment through the referral system the video's own promoted activity rather than reported or criticized conduct. It explains that people who register are added to the member's weakest or selected business leg and encourages distributing placement-specific links as the team grows, linking the requested enrollment to expansion of a referral-based team structure. The supplied records do not establish an investment payment, promised return, sensitive-data request, completed enrollment, or participant loss, so the supported rationale is limited to the video's active recruitment and structured referral-placement mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary mechanism is recruitment into a structured team with left/right business legs and placement controls. This supports a recruitment-matrix or downline-related mechanism, although the supplied evidence does not explicitly state commissions, income dependence, paid tiers, or qualification requirements.
